main_text.p: cum navale habebant Lacedæmonii: de quo igni cum ipsis navibus dando ad vires Lacedæmoniis incidendas consilium quondam Atheniensibus suggessisse Themistocles, sed id autore Aristide ab Atheniensibus esse repudiatum, perhibetur.
main_text.head: IV. APPENDIX DESCRIPTIONI REIPU-BLICAE LACONICAE subjicienda: Complexa historiam succinctam labentis reipubl. & status, tum fortunæ Lacedæmoniorum.
main_text.p: Cuiusmodi respublica Laconica fuerit, hactenus nobis expositum: nunc quomodo, & per quos gradus pessum iver[?] breviter dicemus. Nervos ei incisos[?] fuisse, & vires fractas bellis Theban[?] ostendimus. Accessere clades bello cro, cui sese cum Atheniensibus Lacedæmonii quoque miscuere, acceptæ, jam pene despectui inter reliquas illustres Græciæ civitates Spartana habetur. Causa labentis fortunæ præcip
[?] Reading of the word marked above is doubtful.

page.notes: Margins: faint reversed letters on the right and left edges are show-through from the other side of the leaf; not transcribed. Short strokes after "quondam", "pessum", "Theban" and "fuisse" are printed line-filling marks, not transcribed. "pessum iver[?]": the word may be incomplete on the scan. "incisos[?]" and "Theban[?]" are not fully legible at the line ends. The initial C is a woodcut, joined to "uiusmodi" as "Cuiusmodi". The paragraph continues on the next page ("præcip-" goes on there).
